rationale: A deliberately minimal input vocabulary maps touch/keyboard events to tightly coupled animation-and-sound responses, turning the browser itself into a portable instrument.
notes: The official page describes Patatap as a portable animation and sound kit and explicitly states that it was made with Two.js.

decision.rationale: Canonical example of low-latency one-action/one-response audiovisual mapping with almost no chrome, useful for understanding expressive interfaces and immediate feedback.
